title: Go: Variadic Functions
description: Write and call variadic functions that accept a variable number of arguments.

steps.title: Variadic Parameter
steps.description: Write a function `sum(nums ...int) int` that adds all numbers and returns the sum. Call it with `1, 2, 3, 4, 5`.
hints: `func sum(nums ...int) int { total := 0; for _, n := range nums { total += n }; return total }`
Inside the function, `nums` is a `[]int` slice.

verification.failureMessage: Write sum(...int) that adds 1+2+3+4+5=15 and print.

steps.title: Spread Operator
steps.description: Create a slice `nums := []int{10, 20, 30}` and pass it to a variadic `sum` function using the spread `...` syntax.

verification.failureMessage: Pass a slice [10,20,30] to sum using ... and print 60.

steps.title: Multiple Params + Variadic
steps.description: Write a function `greet(prefix string, names ...string)` that prints the prefix followed by all names. Call it with `"Hello"` and several names.
hints: `func greet(prefix string, names ...string) { for _, n := range names { fmt.Println(prefix, n) } }`
The variadic parameter must be the last one.

verification.test: output.includes('Hello Alice') && output.includes('Hello Bob') && output.includes('Hello Charlie')
verification.failureMessage: Write greet(prefix, names...) that prints each name prefixed by 'Hello'.

steps.title: Slice Passed to Variadic
steps.description: Create a function `max(nums ...int) int` that finds the max. Create a slice `vals := []int{3, 7, 2, 9, 5}` and pass it using `...`.
hints: Implement max by iterating and tracking the highest.

verification.failureMessage: Find max of [3,7,2,9,5] using a variadic max function.

steps.title: append as Variadic
steps.description: Use the built-in `append` function with the spread `...` operator to merge two slices `a := []int{1, 2, 3}` and `b := []int{4, 5, 6}`. Print the result.

verification.test: output.includes('1') && output.includes('2') && output.includes('3') && output.includes('4') && output.includes('5') && output.includes('6')
verification.failureMessage: Merge [1,2,3] and [4,5,6] using append(a, b...) and print.
